items.question: What is NeoSapien MCP?
items.answer: MCP connects your AI assistant to your NeoSapien memories. Your AI can search, retrieve and reference everything you have recorded — without copy-pasting or switching apps.

items.question: Which AI tools are supported?
items.answer: Any AI tool that supports MCP, such as Claude or ChatGPT Pro. Tools without MCP support won't work.

items.question: Do I need to set it up every time?
items.answer: No. It's a one-time setup. Once connected, NeoSapien stays available in your AI tool.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Your memories are shared only with the AI tool you connect, over an authenticated (OAuth) sign-in. You can remove NeoSapien from your connectors at any time.

items.question: What if my AI says it cannot find memories?
items.answer: Add “from NeoSapien” to your message. If it still doesn't work, re-authenticate or remove and re-add NeoSapien from your connectors.

items.question: How do I get my API key?
items.answer: MCP uses OAuth sign-in, so there's no API key to paste — just sign in with your NeoSapien account when prompted.

items.question: Can I use the same account across multiple AI tools?
items.answer: Yes. Sign in with the same NeoSapien account in each tool to reach the same memories everywhere.

blocks.title: AI says it has no tools or cannot find MCP
bullets: Restart your AI app after adding the NeoSapien MCP. The tool only loads on startup.

blocks.title: Hammer icon not showing in Claude Desktop
bullets: Check claude_desktop_config.json for JSON formatting errors. Ensure the file is in the correct directory.

blocks.title: AI finds no memories
bullets: Add 'from NeoSapien MCP' to your prompt. Without this trigger the AI may not query your memories. Restart the app if it persists.

blocks.title: MCP server timeout
bullets: Check your internet connection. The server at api.neosapien.xyz/mcp must be reachable.

blocks.title: Config changes not taking effect
bullets: Fully quit and relaunch the app, not just reload.
